acceptanceCriteria: A single protocol-owned interface description is the only source for names, types, requiredness, defaults, and enum values projected into CLI, MCP, and the three generated reference regions.

A deterministic repository-owned command or test regenerates/checks all three reference regions from the protocol description without network, current time, repository observation, validation subprocesses, or machine-specific paths.

Changing one canonical interface fact causes focused CLI, MCP, and documentation checks to detect and project the same change; two consecutive generations are byte-identical and do not overwrite surrounding human-authored explanation.
The existing active-conversation language contract remains explicit: adapter calls use en, zh, or ja; Contract source text, JSON field names, enum values, and evidence facts are not translated.
goal: Make the work-item outcome interface description the deterministic source for CLI, MCP, and the checked-in reference projections, with an executable generation/check path and evidence that one interface fact change propagates without hand-editing multiple projections.
intent: Reduce repeated interface maintenance while preserving the existing human Outcome language contract: adapters pass the active conversation language explicitly, and Contract/evidence facts remain unchanged.
outOfScope: Outcome rendering or delivery semantics; host/chat connectors; lifecycle
and changes to Contract/evidence fact translation.
scope: crates/cockpit-protocol/src/interface_description.rs; crates/cockpit-cli/src/main.rs and interface parity tests; crates/cockpit-mcp/src/lib.rs and schema tests; docs/reference/commands.md
docs/reference/commands.ja.md generated interface-facts regions; a repository-owned deterministic generation/check helper; focused documentation and interface tests.
verification: cargo test --locked -p cockpit-protocol --test interface_description -p cockpit-cli --test cli_mcp_outcome_parity
